task.title: Review, Stage, and Commit Changes
task.shortdesc: Review local edits, set aside work when needed, stage the changes you want, and commit them to your local repository.

context.p: Use the view to inspect and manage local changes before you commit. Modified files appear in the area, and staging files moves them into the area, ready to commit. From the same view, you can stash changes if you need a clean working copy before you are ready to commit.

result.p: The Git Client records the staged changes as a commit in your local repository. Push the changes when you are ready to share them.
